name_zh: 尼日利亚·奥巴费米·阿沃洛沃：联邦约鲁巴与免费教育区域自治
name_en: Nigeria Obafemi Awolowo: Federal Yoruba Free Education Regional Autonomy
description_zh: 奥巴费米·阿沃洛沃 (1909-1987) 尼日利亚西部地区总理 (1954-1960)，推行全非洲首个免费初等教育，建立约鲁巴联邦区域自治模式，联邦主义思想奠定尼日利亚第一共和国宪法基础。
description_en: Obafemi Awolowo (1909-1987) Nigeria Western Region Premier (1954-1960), implemented Africas first free primary education, built Yoruba federal regional autonomy model, federalist thought laid Nigeria First Republic constitutional foundation.
reason_zh: 阿沃洛沃代表非洲联邦主义先驱如何通过教育普及与区域自治构建民族整合，展示了约鲁巴精英如何在多民族国家中平衡联邦权力与区域发展，其免费教育政策至今惠及千万尼日利亚人。
reason_en: Awolowo represents African federalism pioneer achieving national integration through education universalization and regional autonomy, demonstrating how Yoruba elites balanced federal power and regional development in multi-ethnic nation, his free education policy still benefits millions of Nigerians today.
steps_zh: 研究阿沃洛沃早年律师与尼日利亚青年运动领袖
分析1955年西部地区免费初等教育政策实施
探讨约鲁巴联邦主义与伊博豪萨三大族群博弈
评估1963年联邦制宪法与第一共和国总理竞选
总结联邦约鲁巴免费教育区域自治对尼日利亚民主化的奠基贡献
steps_en: Study Awolowo early lawyer and Nigerian Youth Movement leader
Analyze 1955 Western Region free primary education policy implementation
Explore Yoruba federalism and Igbo-Hausa three major groups game
Evaluate 1963 federal constitution and First Republic PM candidacy
Summarize federal Yoruba free education regional autonomy foundational contribution to Nigerian democratization
expected_zh: 掌握联邦主义与免费教育双轮驱动民族整合逻辑，理解区域自治如何在多民族国家中平衡中心与地方，评估阿沃洛沃对尼日利亚民主宪政传统的决定性奠基。
expected_en: Master federalism and free education dual-wheel driving national integration logic, understand how regional autonomy balances center and periphery in multi-ethnic nation, evaluate Awolowo decisive foundation for Nigerian democratic constitutional tradition.
case_zh: 1955 免费教育；1960 总理候选；1987 逝世。联邦约鲁巴免费教育区域自治范式永存。
case_en: 1955 free education; 1960 PM candidate; 1987 death. Federal Yoruba free education regional autonomy paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Free education; federalism; regional autonomy; Yoruba identity
